# VPA Documentation Changelog

## Overview

This changelog tracks all significant updates to VPA documentation during the planning stage. Each entry includes the date, document name, version update, and a summary of changes.

## August 29, 2025

### VOICE_SYSTEM_DOCUMENTATION_ANALYSIS.md (v1.0)
- Initial creation of documentation analysis
- Completed cross-check of voice system documentation
- Identified alignment areas and gaps in documentation
- Provided recommendations for documentation enhancement

### VOICE_SYSTEM_SINGLE_VOICE_IMPLEMENTATION.md (v1.0)
- Initial creation of single voice implementation document
- Formalized the decision to use only one user-selected voice for TTS
- Removed multi-voice conversation functionality from scope
- Updated integration guidelines for single-voice approach

### VPA_DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md (v1.0)
- Created master index of all planning documents
- Established document categorization system
- Defined version control guidelines
- Added cross-document reference standards
